_comment: French dialogues for voice-cli cut-off-bench: answers cut off one after the other, as when the user speaks over Maé. A turn with cutAfter is cut once the model has written that many tokens (what the voice had been given by then goes into the history, cut off); one without is heard to its end. The first dialogue cuts every answer, as in the app on 2026-10-20 (« Raconte-moi en six phrases … », then « Attends, attends » about 3 s into the answer, ten times): after a few, the model wrote the cut-off mark « […] » itself, more of them each time. The others cut one answer early, then ask what a user who did not hear its end would ask, without saying they cut it off: only the history can tell the model that its answer did not reach its end. In all of them, « Attends, attends » asks Maé to wait: she listens, she does not say her answer again.
